coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

notes.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- an idealized rectangle (owner-directed construction: shares Venue's real east edge and orientation, widened to the real 3rd St curb line) not a hand trace or surveyed footprint. Esri satellite imagery shows what appears to be a real structure across much of this area (a roof pattern resembling built construction, not open land or a parking lot), but its name, address, and completion status are NOT confirmed by any source checked in this pass -- flagged here rather than guessed. status/use are carried over from the OCII plan designation (a residential block on the 3W/3E line, matching Venue), not independently confirmed for this specific structure.
notes.digitized_from: Owner-directed construction, not a hand trace: Venue's own minimum-rotated-rectangle east edge (72.07m, the edge facing 3rd St) extended east as a rectangle of the same length and orientation, widened until it reaches the real 3rd St curb line (src/street_geometry.py buffer, half-width 6.8m).
